purpose: Isolate peak LR as the only changing training variable on the exact v14a7 clip_0p5 pulse, testing whether a tiny learning rate, rather than gradient clipping, blocks teacher-forced target learning.

fixed_controls.canonical_parent: same canonical v14a2 checkpoint, verified SHA256 per arm
fixed_controls.tokenizer: tokenizer_v9 and exact special ID contract enforced by v14a6/v14a7
fixed_controls.model_config: same canonical model config checked against MODEL_CONFIG
fixed_controls.training_rows: same 28 v14a6/v14a7 authored chosen rows, 4 per family
fixed_controls.sampler: v14a6.TargetPulseSampler identical seed+801 and round-robin order, cross-arm batch-ID equality asserted
fixed_controls.seed: v14a7 default seed reset before each arm
fixed_controls.optimizer: fresh AdamW per arm, all parameters trainable
fixed_controls.objective: full chosen continuation CE, prompt tokens masked, identical v14a7 function

metrics.primary: v14a6.score_exact_targets NLL/top1 on exact 28 target rows
metrics.secondary: v14a4 evaluate_clean_family on same gradient clipping semantic holdout
metrics.audit: full train_steps.jsonl including LR, sampled batch IDs, unclipped gradient norms, clipping coefficients per arm
metrics.baseline_replication: v14a7 clip_0p5 final u40 NLL and top1 must match within absolute tolerance 0.005

decision.token_learning: Same v14a6 rule, baseline NLL improvement >= max(0.05,0.01*baseline NLL) OR top1 improvement >= 0.02
decision.lr_scale_bottleneck_supported: lr_2e-8 baseline fails and one or more higher LR arms passes
decision.lr_scale_alone_did_not_restore_learning: baseline fails and all larger LR arms fail

scientific_limit: One-factor diagnostic, not causal proof of broad model trainability. Larger LR can harm other tasks; no checkpoint promotion.
